run_fuse_gmock: run fuse_gmock_files.py with an output directory to fuse gmock and gtest source into three files
run_fuse_gmock_with_root: run fuse_gmock_files.py with a gmock root directory and output directory to generate fused headers
fuse_gmock_h: call FuseGMockH to scan a gmock root and generate a single fused gmock.h header file
fuse_gmock_gtest_all_cc: call FuseGMockGTestAllCc to generate a single gmock-gtest-all.cc source file combining gtest and gmock
validate_gmock_root_dir: call ValidateGMockRootDir to verify a gmock root directory contains the required seed files
